body:
Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task, the maintainer's words quoted verbatim. Filed from the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (account `os-elon-musk`) by the research thread 车队机制迁往 Projects on the maintainer's word there. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane self-applied under exception 二; grade suggested p3 · S; triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023), in-seat subagent S card: `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the query spots named below, and one small script. No `.claude/**`.
## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, project thread 车队机制迁往 Projects, verbatim)

> 我的账户清单不固定的， 20x 周流量用完了，我就会换另外一个账户。 (06:27Z)
> 具体的分配应该是我人工制定的。 (06:27Z)
> 然后是否应该有一张总表能看到哪些账户在负责哪些车道，包括状态等 (06:38Z)
> 或者你不要强调是谁 (11:46Z)
> 你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务，跟踪落地 (12:13Z)

The research memo these cards implement: https://claude.ai/artifact/VFTHWcmKkzbah17UM8KRqm (sections 10, 13; private to the maintainer's account).

## What was measured

- Mailbox PRs work (#25392: woken by a relay comment in 70 s and by an `os-bill` comment in 4 s) but they are PRs: `Check Changeset` reddened on the empty diff, and a `head:claude/` ledger query (`landing-operations.md` L26) would count them as awaiting landing. #25392 used this thread's `claude/project-thread-v23o7q` branch because the designated branch was the only one it could push; the real form uses `mailbox/<login>`.
- The mailbox protocol text itself (one draft PR per lane project, `To: <login>` first line, never merged, closed on handover) is a sibling skills card; this card is the tooling.

## Wanted

- `ensure-pm-labels.sh` gains `pm:mailbox` (description: a project's cross-account mailbox PR; never merged; owes no CI; excluded from ledgers).
- Every script that enumerates open `head:claude/` PRs for landing (grep `head:claude/` and `pr_ready` readers under `scripts/pm/`) adds `-label:pm:mailbox`; the daily digest and the roster (sibling card) do the same.
- `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo <slug> --login <login>`: creates branch `mailbox/<login>` from `main` with one empty commit, opens the draft PR through the relay (`pr_create` + `labels: ["pm:mailbox"]`), prints the PR number for `subscribe_pr_activity`; `--close <n>` posts the closing line and `issue_patch` state closed. Refuses if an open `pm:mailbox` PR for that login already exists.
- A CI exemption for `pm:mailbox` PRs where a workflow allows it by label (changeset check), otherwise documented as 「red by design」 in the PR body template the script writes.

## Acceptance

- Label present in all three repos after the seat runs the script; `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` green; a dry run against objectstack prints the actions file without sending.
- `git grep -n 'head:claude/' scripts/pm` shows every hit paired with the mailbox exclusion or a comment saying why not.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "pm-dispatch project forms … mailbox PR" (shared with the project-forms card) → 52 hits, none about a mailbox label or script; `git grep -n -i mailbox scripts/pm .claude/skills` → 0 hits. **New.**

Dedupe words: `pm:mailbox` · `mailbox-open.mjs`.
